expected.notes: What this case tests, in plain English: Miniti can send the same meeting to Vector more than once (here as 'meeting.updated', e.g. after it regenerates the summary). The eval runner sends this exact payload TWICE. The first delivery should behave like any normal meeting: mark 'Connect dbt repo' done and draft the KPI one-pager task (noting to set up a review working session with the customer once it's done). The second delivery has the same meeting id, so Vector must recognise it as already processed and do nothing: no second event, no duplicate drafts. If you ever see two copies of the KPI one-pager draft in the inbox after a single meeting, this is the case that should have caught it.
